title: Why Didn't Jensen Huang Just Join Another Company? #Shorts
description:
Why didn't Jensen Huang just join another company? We don't know what he was thinking - but his moves are on record: he resigned on 12 Nov, the FT reported on 15 Nov that he discussed a comeback with confidants, on 17 Nov he said he would be 'honoured' to return, and on 23 Nov he was back. Our guess: Nvidia, the company he co-founded and led for 33 years, is his life's work.

Sources (checked 24 Nov 2026):
- NVIDIA 8-K, CEO transition (12 Nov 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm
- FT report via CTV News: https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/jensen-huang-discusses-comeback-as-nvidia-ceo-with-allies-ft-reports/
- NPR (17 Nov): https://www.wamc.org/2026-11-17/nvidia-board-says-it-does-not-intend-to-reinstate-jensen-huang-as-ceo
- NVIDIA 8-K, Huang reinstated (23 Nov 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000090/nov23pressrelease.htm

Allegations mentioned are reports, not proven facts. Our analysis is labelled as such. News, not financial advice.
This video uses an AI-generated presenter (Google Flow) and animations; facts checked against the sources above. Independent channel, not affiliated with NVIDIA.
